purpose: Addendum 40: price the tool's checks at the technicians' own observed pace, so the tool and the technician can be compared in working time. Frozen before any pace-priced number exists.
unit: minutes of working time: doing the check. Travel (access) and waiting are excluded for both competitors, because the videos cut them.

bas_read.what: T212 in the BAS: heat stage, damper position, discharge temperature
T117 in the BAS (no graphic, point list): heat stage, discharge temperature
Area schedule, unoccupied heating setpoint and zone temperature (speaks for two rooms)
Box 250: space temperature, setpoints, thermostat dial and limits

physical_box_inspection.what: T212 electric heat: contactors, 24 V, supply voltage, limit, amps, load-side voltage, fuse continuity
T117 electric heat: fuses and wiring

families.rule: A catalogue check is in the 'bas' family if its place is 'bas' (the bas_* reads); every other check is in the 'physical' family. Mechanical, no judgement.
families.pricing: time of a check = family ratio x that check's catalogue do_min (access and wait_min excluded). The ratio = the technician's observed minutes / the reference check's catalogue do_min.

FAST.basis: the shortest observation in each family

CENTRAL.basis: the mean of the observations in each family (primary)

SLOW.basis: the longest observation in each family

technician_minutes_to_diagnosis.source: compete_cold_morning.json and compete_ep160.json (video minutes, set-up, repair and walking excluded; includes his two steps with no catalogue counterpart in the cold-morning call)

tool_endpoint.primary: the tool's stop (every complaint concluded, or nothing left worth its time)
tool_endpoint.S1_like_for_like_EP160_only: tool stop + the technician's physical confirmation of 3.25 minutes (2.75 + 0.5), added when the tool's session contains no reheat_coil on a complaint; the technician's own endpoint is a physical finding, the tool's usually is not

worlds.sampling_truth_primary_basis: Addendum 39 found that its frozen sampling truth for Room-232 (controller_config) contradicted the video's fixed answer for that room (bas_zone abnormal), so the world contradicted itself. Primary here uses a truth consistent with the fixed answers. This was chosen AFTER seeing Addendum 39's exploratory result, which is disclosed; Addendum 39's own truth is reported as sensitivity S2.

decision.TOOL_FASTER: median(tool time) / technician time <= 0.8 AND the tool is right on every complaint in at least 90% of worlds
decision.robustness: ROBUST if the label is the same in FAST, CENTRAL and SLOW; otherwise SENSITIVE TO PACE
